【原视频简介】
Completely Updated Apple Pie Recipe with Precooked Caramel Juices & All-Butter Crust for a Never-Runny Perfect Slice
If apple pie has intimidated you — shrinking crusts, soggy bottoms, or filling that boils over — this step-by-step masterclass shows you how to fix it for good.

📌 This is my 2026 COMPLETE REMAKE — newly filmed start to finish with a new all-butter shingled crust and precooked caramel-juice method. Not a re-upload of my classic apple pie.  Here is a link to my original apple pie: https://youtu.be/KQHJCpZZOK8  (This was my very first video ever.  I knew how to make a pie, but did not know how to make a video LOL).

PRINTABLE RECIPE:  https://docs.google.com/document/d/1o2vwmO8qE82-p-nlOLV57cRX8UWdkL1WIKOl6h30DGg/edit?usp=sharing

Look how beautiful this is! Today I'm sharing my completely updated apple pie — tender, shatteringly flaky all-butter crust (shingled, no laminating folds) and Granny Smith apples that hold their shape in a glossy, perfect-consistency filling.

THE SCIENCE: We macerate the apples with sugars to draw out the juices, then precook those juices with flour into a rich caramel sauce on the stovetop. Once cooled to about 70°F, we stir it back into the apples before baking. Result: the filling is already set, bake time is shorter, and you'll never get that filling eruption or watery pool.

IN THIS VIDEO YOU'LL LEARN:
• How to shingle cold butter for a tender, flaky all-butter crust that doesn't shrink or melt
• Why to macerate first, then cook juices in…
